text: Abanca is the Galician banking ally of Banesco Internacional; Banesco Internacional states that its founder and principal shareholder, the banker and economist Juan Carlos Escotet Rodríguez, is also the principal shareholder of Abanca. Abanca's 2025 corporate governance report says Escotet is the bank's effective owner (titular efectivo) with 84.75% of the share capital, 43.50% held directly and 41.25% through the Spanish company Escotet Family Office S.L.U., and that no other shareholder holds more than 5%.
short: Juan Carlos Escotet Rodríguez is Abanca's effective owner, with 84.75% of the share capital.

source.name: Banesco Internacional, 'Nosotros'
source.quote: El fundador y principal accionista de Banesco Internacional es el banquero y economista Juan Carlos Escotet Rodríguez, quien también es el principal accionista de nuestro aliado ABANCA
